slides.title: HEIGHTMAXXING
slides.subtitle: Vertical sleep
slides.body: Lying down for 8 hours lets gravity compress you {r:sideways}. Sleeping upright in a wardrobe redirects gravity {g:downwards}, where it belongs. Studies* show wardrobes are 100% taller than beds.

slides.title: HEIGHTMAXXING
slides.subtitle: How do it right
steps: Wear {r:3 pairs} of socks (+0.9 cm instantly)
Only stand next to friends shorter than you
Take photos from the floor. The floor never lies

slides.title: HEIGHTMAXXING
slides.subtitle: CONCLUSION
slides.body: After 30 days of the Wardrobe Protocol I am still {r:5'7}, but now I own a {g:very organized wardrobe}. Ascension is a mindset. *source: trust me bro (2026)
